text: Why is it showing in orange color?

The issue is on lines 2273 and 2328. The `▶️` emoji uses an emoji variation selector (U+FE0F), which forces OS emoji rendering — CSS `color` and `filter` are ignored for emoji-rendered characters.

The fix is to use the plain text `▶` (no variation selector) which responds to CSS `color`.**Root cause:** `▶️` contains a Unicode variation selector (U+FE0F) that forces the browser to render it as an emoji using the OS emoji font.
